description.en: A deep-sea dive splash screen for DeepSeek Harness startup: a depth gauge with a submersible probe, a character reveal video that then loops seamlessly, seafloor relief, coral reef, bubbles and bioluminescent particles. The depth reached decides which sea creatures appear.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的深海下潜式启动动画：深度尺与探测器、之后无缝循环的角色出场视频、海底地形与珊瑚礁、气泡与生物荧光粒子。下潜到哪一层，就出现哪一层的海洋生物。
